records.name: Rebellion Spear
records.mechanics: 100 Ki; brief preparation followed by a roughly 5-second lariat-like rush around the target leaving a Ki trail.

records.name: Spirit Explosion
records.mechanics: 200 Stamina; close-range blue explosion Evasive that knocks nearby opponents away and can activate while taking damage.

records.name: Evil Ray Strike
records.mechanics: 100 Ki; head-first charge after a stance; successful hit breaks the target's guard even while blocking.

records.name: Evil Rise Strike
records.mechanics: 100 Ki; upward semicircle rush useful against airborne targets; gains damage against knocked-back opponents.
